model: BMS-IFMB0UEW-E Modbus RTU interface for ESTIA air-to-water heat pumps
applies_to: Toshiba BMS-IFMB0UEW-E MB interface on ESTIA R410A 4 Series and 5 Series (WM type) and R32 1 Series (WM and AIO type) hydro units, user manual EEU-006 issued 31/05/2021.
summary: The BMS-IFMB0UEW-E clips onto the AB remote-controller bus (AW-LINK or TU2C-LINK) of a Toshiba ESTIA hydro unit and answers as a Modbus RTU slave. Everything is a signed 16-bit holding register: zone and hot-water on/off, mode, setpoints, the special functions (auto temp, night setback, boost, frost protection, anti-bacteria), alarm status and code, sensor temperatures, running-hour counters, the setpoint limits and the interface's own configuration.

addressing.note: The manual gives the rule directly: start address in the request = printed register number - 40001. So 40001 is wire address 0 and 40201 is wire address 200.

source.title: TOSHIBA MB interface BMS-IFMB0UEW-E User Manual (Modbus RTU (RS-485) Interface for Toshiba Air to Water Heat Pump)
source.pages: p. 5 connection; p. 6 physical layer, addressing rule, data type; pp. 6-8 registers; pp. 9-10 DIP switches; p. 11 functions, LEDs, termination; pp. 12-14 supported units and check codes

notes: Toshiba does not appear to host this manual publicly; the link is an unaltered copy of Toshiba Carrier Air-Conditioning Europe's manual on the Dutch distributor Intercool's download centre.
The manual states every register is a 16-bit signed holding register, so all entries are INT16 (the bit field 40066 is shown as BITMAP16).

Temperature scale is chosen by DIP switch S4 bit 1: whole degrees (x1, default) or decidegrees (x10). A further S4 switch selects Celsius (default) or Fahrenheit. The files' scale of 1 matches the default; set scale 0.1 if S4 bit 1 is ON.
The manual marks per register which of R32 1 Series, 5 Series and 4 Series supports it. Every listed register is marked for all three, except 40018 (not on 4 Series) and 40066 (R32 1 Series only).
The check-code list (section 6) maps alarm-code numbers to remote-controller codes such as A01 or E03; it is not copied here because the extracted table rows do not line up reliably.

integration.summary: Connect the interface to the hydro unit's AB terminals (TB07 on 4/5 Series, TB04 on R32 1 Series) and to RS-485, then poll 40001-40025 with function 3 and write single registers with function 6.
integration.enable: No enable step: set the hydro unit type (S1), slave address and baud rate (S3) and temperature format/termination (S4) on the interface's DIP switches; the values can also be read over Modbus.
quirks: Function 16 is accepted but only with a length of 1; write one register per request.
Temperature reads of 0x8000 mean no sensor or a sensor error.
Temperatures are whole degrees unless DIP S4 bit 1 is ON, so the same register reads 45 or 450 depending on the switch.
setup: Serial format is 8 data bits, no parity, 2 stop bits (8N1-compatible); baud 2400/4800/9600 (default)/19200 via DIP S3.
Only one remote controller (header) may stay on the AB bus; a sub remote controller cannot be connected.
The AB bus between interface and hydro unit is unpolarised and limited to 50 m; RS-485 is polarised (A+, B-), up to 500 m, with 120 ohm termination at each end (on-board resistor via S4 bit 4).
gotchas: Setting zone temperatures from Modbus may still give lower water temperatures, depending on the remote controller's FC/DN settings.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
